prescription.name: Prescription Medicine
prescription.definition: Scheduled medicines requiring a valid doctor's prescription in Malaysia under the Poison Act 1952.

otc.name: Over-the-Counter (OTC)
otc.definition: Non-prescription medications available directly from community pharmacies for self-limiting symptoms.

supplement.name: Health Supplement
supplement.definition: Vitamins, minerals, amino acids, and dietary supplements evaluated and registered by NPRA for safety.

traditional.name: Traditional & Natural Product
traditional.definition: Herbal remedies, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), Ayurvedic, and Jamu preparations registered with NPRA.

veterinary.name: Veterinary Medicine
veterinary.definition: Pharmaceutical products formulated exclusively for veterinary healthcare.
